बवाल खबर! सलमान खान को लेकर आ रही है एकदम मस्त अपडेट। 🔥
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, सलमान खान ने अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Monster की शूटिंग पुणे में शुरू कर दी है।
पिंकविला की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, यह शूटिंग शेड्यूल 15 नवंबर से शुरू हुआ है और दस दिनों तक चलेगा।
सोर्स का कहना है कि इस शेड्यूल में सलमान खान और सीमा विश्वास कुछ इंटेंस और ड्रामेटिक सीन्स की शूटिंग कर रहे हैं। 🎬
फिल्म में सलमान खान के साथ लीड रोल में नयनतारा नजर आएंगी, और दोनों की यह पहली फिल्म होगी।
डायरेक्टर वामसी पेडिपल्ली की इस फिल्म का टीजर 27 नवंबर को सलमान खान के जन्मदिन पर आने की चर्चा है।
फिल्म को हिंदी, तेलुगु और तमिल में बनाया जा रहा है और यह साल 2027 में ईद पर रिलीज हो सकती है।
हालांकि, मेकर्स की तरफ से अभी तक कोई आधिकारिक ऐलान नहीं किया गया है। ⚡
क्या आप सलमान खान और नयनतारा की इस नई जोड़ी को बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

The film, directed by Vamshi Paidipally, is expected to feature intense sequences, with a teaser reportedly planned for December 27, coinciding with Khan’s birthday.
Salman Khan has reportedly begun shooting for his upcoming film Monster , which also stars Nayanthara in the female lead. The actor, who is currently awaiting the release of Maatrubhumi , has started a 10-day shooting schedule in Pune for the film. According to reports, the latest schedule commenced on November 15 and will feature some of the most dramatic sequences in the project.
According to a report by Pinkvilla, the ongoing Pune schedule is an important phase of the film's production, with the makers filming several intense moments that are expected to play a crucial role in the storyline. A source told the portal, “Salman Khan and Seema Biswas are part of this Pune schedule, and the makers are shooting some intense and dramatic moments, with the ongoing leg marking an important phase in the film’s production. The shoot is expected to continue in the city for the next 10 days.”
Meanwhile, the makers are reportedly planning a special surprise for Salman Khan's fans. As per reports, the team is considering unveiling the film's teaser on December 27, coinciding with the actor's birthday. If the plan materialises, audiences could get their first glimpse into the world of Monster on the occasion.
Monster will mark the first on-screen collaboration between Salman Khan and Nayanthara. While the two actors are set to share screen space for the first time, the makers have kept details about their respective characters and the film's storyline under wraps.
The project is being directed by Vamshi Paidipally, who is known for films such as Maharshi and Varisu . The film is being developed as a pan-India project and will be made in Hindi, Telugu and Tamil. Dil Raju is presenting the film under the banner of Sri Venkateswara Creations, with Shirish, Kuldeep Rathore and Rafi Kazi attached as co-producers.
According to Filmfare, Monster has been finalised as the title of the Salman-Nayanthara starrer. However, an official announcement from the production house is still awaited and is expected to be shared on social media.
On the release front, Monster is reportedly targeting an Eid 2027 theatrical release. The festival period has been associated with several of Salman Khan's previous releases, making it a familiar release window for the actor.
The film will also add another multilingual project to Nayanthara's growing body of work across Tamil, Telugu and Hindi cinema. While the Pune schedule is reportedly underway, the makers are yet to officially confirm the film's title, release timeline, teaser plans and other details.
